title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E22 — Blood on the Land
Jeb Drummond is a murderous sheep herder who has Adam taken hostage to try and force Ben to sign over a large section of Ponderosa land to him.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E25 — Escape to the Ponderosa
Adam is taken hostage by a band of U.S. Army prisoners who have escaped and sought refuge on the Ponderosa.

title: Tulsa
description: A cattle rancher's daughter (Susan Hayward) turns Oklahoma wildcatter with a geologist (Robert Preston) and an Indian (Pedro Armendáriz) as partners.

title: Under California Stars
description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers.

title: West of the Divide
description: Ted and Dusty infiltrate a band of outlaws to get close to Mr. Gentry, the man who murdered Ted's father.

title: Randy Rides Alone
description: Government agent Randy Bowers (John Wayne) is accused of shooting up a saloon and has to escape from the jail to find the man behind the murders.

title: Hell Town
description: A rancher (John Mack Brown) makes his cousin (John Wayne) trail boss on a cattle drive headed for trouble.

title: Death Valley
description: When a young man discovers gold, he must deal with threats.

title: Idaho
description: A state ranger (Roy Rogers) clears a crusading judge framed for a bank robbery.

title: Loser's End
description: A cowboy (Jack Perrin) and his sidekick (Frank Rice) pursue a gang of smugglers and save a Mexican dancer (Tina Menard).

title: Daughter of the West
description: A convent-raised woman (Martha Vickers) learns of her American Indian heritage through romance with an educated Navajo (Philip Reed) during the 1880s.

title: Hawk of the Hills
description: Led by "The Hawk," a band of Indians terrorizes prospectors in a California valley.

title: Brand of the Devil
description: Tex Wyatt (Dave "Tex" O'Brien), Jim Steel (Jim Newill) and Panhandle Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) are Texas Rangers working undercover to bust up a cattle rustling ring that leaves cards bearing a devilish pitchfork to announce its presence.

title: The Terror of Tiny Town
description: A cast of little people populates this musical about a peaceful village incited to violence by an outlaw.

title: Springtime in the Sierras
description: A gang of poachers must be stopped as they kill and sell game out of season. Roy figures out who the culprits are and goes undercover to investigate further.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E17 — Dog Story
A dog leads Cisco and Pancho to his murdered master's gold mine where they become trapped by the victim's killers.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E18 — Confession for Money
Cisco proves that the man being held in jail on a murder charge is not the actual murderer.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E19 — The Old Bum
A respectable businessman traps an elderly man into a rustling ring scheme that Pancho and Cisco later discover.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E20 — Haven for Heavies
Cisco and Pancho set out to prove that a notorious outlaw has murdered a U.S. marshal.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E22 — Little Britches
A young woman meets an outlaw; Matt investigates a railroad holdup.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E21 — The Doolin Gang
Frankie poses as a gang member's wife but gets caught.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E23 — Black Jack Ketchum
An outlaw convinces the son of a former gang-member to join his gang.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E24 — Tom Horn
Matt's old friend, Tom Horn, turns into an outlaw and starts a land war.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E32 — Revenge
A young lieutenant seeks blind vengeance for the brutal murders of his parents by warmongering Shawnee.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E33 — The Contest
Hawkeye and Chingachgook match their wits against two thieves who have phony identities.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E34 — The Truant
Hawkeye and Chingachgook escort young Greg to the boy's Aunt Emma and Uncle Mort; Greg inherits his parents' valuable mine which makes him a target.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E35 — The Royal Grant
Cressing claims to have a royal grant giving him ownership of the town.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E36 — The Long Rifles
Someone is selling illegal guns to the Indians and the townspeople blame gunsmith Eben Cotten.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E37 — The Printer
Freedom of the press is threatened when the editor is framed for murder.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E38 — The Indian Doll
Little Snowbird falls into a deep trance after Hawkeye presents her with a doll.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E39 — Circle of Hate
Ever since Lt. Smith joined Col. Courtney's command, unexplained Indian deaths have increased and threatens to ignite a war between the colonial forces and the Iroquois nation.

title: Hurricane Horseman
description: A gunsmith (Lane Chandler) offers to fix outlaws' guns if they release their hostage to him.

title: Yellowneck
description: A sergeant (Lin McCarthy), a colonel (Stephen Courtleigh), a thief (Berry Kroeger) and two other Rebel deserters trek toward Cuba through the Everglades.

title: Six-Gun Trail
description: Posing as an Asian, a Washington agent goes after a gem-smuggling outlaw gang.

title: The Lucky Texan
description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne) and his friend Jake (George Hayes) have to keep two crooks away from their gold.

title: Sagebrush Trail
description: A man is falsely imprisoned on a murder charge, then escapes to join an outlaw gang and unmask the real killer.

title: Vengeance Valley
description: A rancher's son (Robert Walker) gets his foster brother (Burt Lancaster) in trouble with an unwed mother's brothers.

title: The Last of the Clintons
description: A cowboy sleuth (Harry Carey) catches rustlers despite a rattlesnake.

title: Raiders of Red Gap
description: The Lone Rider (Bob Livingston) and his sidekick (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) crunch an Arizona grazing-land monopoly.

title: The Kansan
description: The new marshal (Richard Dix) of a Kansas town cracks down on his sponsor, a greedy banker (Albert Dekker).

title: Call of the Forest
description: A young boy's camaraderie with wild animals comes in handy when he sets out to avenge his father's death.

title: The Red Rope
description: Ranch hand Tom Shaw must face off against a nefarious gunslinger to save his lady love's ranch.

title: Abilene Town
description: A saloon singer (Ann Dvorak) and her rival like a marshal (Randolph Scott) who cleans up a drunken sheriff's (Edgar Buchanan) cow town.

title: Phantom Ranger
description: A federal investigator (Tim McCoy) poses as an outlaw to catch a gang of counterfeiters which has kidnapped a government engraver.

title: Arizona Bound
description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) team up to save a woman's stagecoach line from a Mesa City saloon gang.

title: The Man From Music Mountain
description: A singing rancher (Gene Autry) and his sidekick (Smiley Burnette) catch swindlers selling lots in a ghost town.

title: Code of the Fearless
description: A Texas Ranger pretends he has been discharged from service to trick outlaws into accepting him into their gang.

title: Billy the Kid Returns
description: Singing Billy (Roy Rogers) settles a case of mistaken identity with his sidekick, Frog (Smiley Burnette).

title: Bad Man of Deadwood
description: A cowboy (Roy Rogers) hides from his past in a fake professor's (George "Gabby" Hayes) medicine show and helps town outcasts fight civic reformers.

title: Yodelin' Kid From Pine Ridge
description: A singing cowboy rides to the rescue when a feud erupts between cattlemen and turpentine manufacturers.

title: The Hanged Man
description: A former gunslinger survives his own hanging and transforms himself into a mysterious avenger of injustice.

title: Kentucky Rifle
description: Stranded settlers (Chill Wills, Lance Fuller, Cathy Downs) enter hostile territory with a wagonload of rifles.

title: Cry Blood, Apache
description: An old man (Joel McCrea) recalls his days as a young man (Jody McCrea) fighting Indians in the Old West.

title: Enemy of the Law
description: Former Texas Ranger Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), now an attorney, is called back into law enforcement by his old pals Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and Panhandle Perkins (Guy Wilkerson), who want his help recovering some stolen gold.

title: McLintock!
description: A cattle baron (John Wayne) tries to tame his wife (Maureen O'Hara) amid a feud with settlers and trouble with Indians.

title: Land of Hunted Men
description: The Range Busters (Ray Corrigan, Dennis Moore, Max Terhune) track outlaws to their hide-out.

title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
description: When the Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, the only surviving ranger dons a mask to protect his identity and swears to bring them to justice.

title: Lost Canyon
description: After Johnny is accused of robbing a bank, he runs into the hills. When his friend Hopalong Cassidy hears what happened, Hopalong sets out to find the real bad guys.

title: In Old Colorado
description: Hopalong Cassidy stops Joe Weiler from instigating a prairie war between two ranchers.

title: Born to Battle
description: Cattlemen offer a jailed cowboy his freedom if he will agree to help locate a gang of notorious rustlers.

title: Brothers of the West
description: Detective Tom Wade (Tom Tyler) has to investigate the truth behind a robbery and murder of a bank president that's being blamed on Tom's brother, Ed (Bob Terry), who is nowhere to be found.

title: Sitting Bull
description: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).

title: 'Neath Canadian Skies
description: A Mountie tracks mine robbers in the 1890s Canada.

title: Grand Canyon Trail
description: Not long after ambitious prospector J. Malcolm Vanderpool takes an interest in the run-down remnants of a small frontier town, fortune seekers from all over rush to gain a silver mine of their own.

title: Colorado Sundown
description: Rex (Rex Allen) and Slim (Slim Pickens) journey to Colorado, where Slim is expecting to claim the estate of the departed Zeke Reynolds, but the will also includes Jacqueline Reynolds and the evil Hurley siblings, and a fight ensues.

title: Home in Oklahoma
description: A singing newsman (Roy Rogers), a ranch foreman (George "Gabby" Hayes) and a newswoman (Dale Evans) team up to track killers.

title: Bells of San Angelo
description: A writer (Dale Evans) of cowboy novels saves herself and a border agent (Roy Rogers) with a trick from her latest book.

title: In Old Cheyenne
description: A singing reporter (Roy Rogers) and a framed man (George "Gabby" Hayes) put a town boss out of business.

title: Heartland
description: A Denver widow (Conchata Ferrell) with a daughter becomes a Scottish rancher's (Rip Torn) housekeeper in 1910 Wyoming.

title: Captain Apache
description: A full-blooded Apache working for the U.S. Army investigates a colleague's murder and uncovers a plot by a wealthy white farmer to instigate an Indian war; gunplay and bloodshed follow as the investigation deepens.

title: The Way of the West
description: A Mountie moves to a town and begins to stop its illegal activity by busting people one by one.

title: Riders of Destiny
description: Agent Saunders (John Wayne) becomes partners with Fay (Cecelia Parker) to help her fight off a gang run by a local land grabber.

title: Winds of the Wasteland
description: Two former Pony Express riders enter a dilapidated stagecoach in a race for a government mail contract.

title: The Star Packer
description: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

title: Fighting Caravans
description: A French girl (Lily Damita) joins a wagon train from Missouri led by two scouts and their young partner (Gary Cooper).

title: Rage at Dawn
description: A special agent (Randolph Scott) poses as a train robber to infiltrate Frank Reno's (Forrest Tucker) outlaw gang.

title: Outpost in Morocco
description: A French Foreign Legion captain (George Raft) loves an enemy Arab chieftain's daughter (Marie Windsor).
